name: C075 Phù Thủy Hồi Dương (Quyền Trượng Mầm Cây Tử Sinh)
prompt_ref:
Create a single-cell 1x1 reference sheet of an Epic dark-fantasy Life-and-Death Druid's rebirth sapling staff (Quyền Trượng Mầm Cây Tử Sinh - C075 Phù Thủy Hồi Dương) following the exact square cell of the attached reference layout_guide_1x1.png.

COMPOSITION & ORIENTATION (100% MANDATORY):
- Draw ONE complete rebirth staff oriented DIAGONALLY from bottom-left (intertwined bone-and-ancient-bark shaft) to top-right (a horned skull-and-branch cradle holding a radiant golden-emerald World Tree sprout and glowing soul-seed crystal).
- Must show 100% of the entire staff from bottom root-tip to top golden-emerald sprout crown with generous padding inside the frame (occupying 65%-75% of the canvas).
- Zero clipping at canvas edges.

COLOR & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) edge-to-edge.
- DO NOT use any magenta/pink tones on the staff itself (use weathered ivory bone, dark petrified wood, antique gold, and glowing emerald-green & golden-white vitality leaves).
- No character hands, no text, no borders.
prompt_anim_2x2:
Create a 2x2 sprite sheet (4 frames total: row 1 left-to-right, row 2 left-to-right) of the EXACT SAME Life-and-Death Rebirth Sapling Staff from the first attached reference image, following the 2x2 grid layout of the second attached reference image (layout_guide_2x2.png).

100% CONSISTENCY & ANIMATION RULES:
- Every cell must show the exact same diagonal bone-and-wood sapling staff at the exact same angle, size, and position.
- Animate a looping 4-frame resurrection ward aura: luminous emerald-green and golden-white soul-fireflies, blooming vitality runes, and spiraling life-force wisps rising around the sacred sprout.
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) in all 4 cells. DO NOT draw the blue layout guide lines or cell borders. Keep each frame strictly inside its cell with zero clipping.
prompt_card:
Create a wide horizontal 16:11 dark-fantasy card illustration featuring the exact same Life-and-Death Rebirth Sapling Staff (Quyền Trượng Mầm Cây Tử Sinh - C075 Phù Thủy Hồi Dương) from the attached reference images.

COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Place the bone-and-bark sapling staff diagonally across the center of the horizontal frame.
- Full atmospheric dark-fantasy background (100% opaque RGB illustration, NO magenta, NO transparency): an ancient battlefield barrow where golden-emerald rebirth light and floating spirit leaves erupt from the staff, bringing dead roots back to radiant life.
- Do NOT draw any card frame, borders, or text.
